sources.entry: Mathesar - Intuitive UI to manage data collaboratively, for users of all technical skill levels. Built on Postgres – connect an existing DB or set up a new one. (Source Code) GPL-3.0 Docker/Python

summary.one_liner: Mathesar is a self-hosted, spreadsheet-like web interface for viewing, editing, querying, and sharing data in existing or new PostgreSQL databases.
summary.what_it_does: Mathesar provides a spreadsheet-style UI on top of PostgreSQL databases, schemas, and tables without extra abstraction layers. Users can view, create, update, and delete records, and filter, sort, and group data. A query builder called Data Explorer lets users build queries without writing SQL or joins. Users can build forms with a unique link so submissions are saved as new records, and import or export data. It can also create and update schemas and tables, and move columns between tables. Access control uses existing Postgres roles and privileges.
use_cases: edit postgres data in a spreadsheet-style interface
let non-technical users query a database without SQL
collect form submissions into a database table
share database access with collaborators using postgres roles
manage production postgres tables without writing code
how_to_run: Install Mathesar on your own server by following the official documentation (install guide is linked from the README)
Install using Docker, per the documentation
Connect an existing Postgres database or set up a new one from within Mathesar
notable: Works directly on native Postgres schemas, tables, primary keys, foreign keys, and constraints; UI relationships are foreign keys
Uses existing Postgres roles and privileges for access control
Custom data types for emails and URLs validated at the database level
Form links let outside people submit records into tables
Mathesar Cloud hosted option with a free plan (early beta, per README)
caveats: README says the project is in public beta; not yet described as widely used in production
Installation details are only in external documentation, not the README
Mathesar Cloud is in early beta and is a separate hosted service
